title: MAP Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Manifold absolute pressure sensor signal too low.
fullDescription:
Indian Thunder Stroke ECM detects MAP voltage below threshold. Bike runs rich and idles rough.

Common cause: disconnected vacuum line under tank shrouding on Chieftain/Roadmaster.
videoSearchQuery: Indian motorcycle P0107 MAP sensor fix

faq.a: Clear with scan tool or disconnect battery.

title: ECT Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Engine coolant temp sensor signal low.
fullDescription:
On liquid-cooled Indian FTR or Challenger, P0117 means ECT circuit shorted. Air-cooled Thunder Stroke uses rear head temp sensor.

Fan logic and rich-start mapping will not function properly.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Swap sensor, refill coolant if liquid cooled.

videoSearchQuery: Indian motorcycle P0117 ECT sensor fix

title: TPS Circuit Low
shortDescription: Throttle position sensor voltage below range.
fullDescription:
P0122 indicates TPS signal too low. Ride-by-wire models enter reduced-power mode.

Indian throttle bodies are non-serviceable and are replaced as units.

title: Front O2 Sensor Low
shortDescription: Front cylinder O2 sensor circuit low.
fullDescription:
P0131 signals lean or circuit low on front O2 sensor. Indian V-twin owners often see after exhaust swap or header leak.

Replace with OEM narrowband to clear.

faq.a: May need Power Commander or tune to clear.

title: Front Injector Low
fullDescription:
P0261 indicates front cylinder injector circuit fault. Thunder Stroke 111/116 V-twins will shake and lose power.

Diagnose connector, resistance, and driver circuit.

faq.q: Can I run on rear only?
faq.a: Short distance to service — catalyst risk.

title: Front Coil Primary Circuit
fullDescription:
P0351 indicates front coil primary circuit issue. Engine may run on rear cylinder only.

Replace coil and inspect harness for heat damage near engine cases.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM coil and route wires from heat.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription:
P0335 indicates crank sensor missing. Bike will not start.

Common after debris accumulation or after engine service that disturbed sensor.
videoSearchQuery: Indian motorcycle P0335 crank sensor fix

title: Lost Communication with ECM
shortDescription: CAN communication with engine ECM lost.
fullDescription:
U0100 on Indian indicates instrument cluster or BCM cannot reach the ECM over CAN. Multiple warning lights will appear.

Usually harness or fuse issue. Frequent after battery tender disconnect cycle.

fixSteps.title: Check CAN
fixSteps.instruction: CAN H/L ~60 ohm between pins, ~2.5V idle.

videoSearchQuery: Indian motorcycle U0100 ECM communication fix

title: System Voltage Low
fullDescription:
P0562 indicates low system voltage. Could be weak battery, poor charging, or bad grounds.

AGM batteries on Indian can degrade after 3-4 seasons.
videoSearchQuery: Indian motorcycle P0562 low voltage fix

title: Immobilizer/Security Fault
fullDescription:
P1650 indicates Indian security system (key fob) didn't handshake with ECM. Bike won't start.

Key fob battery dying is most common cause.

fixSteps.title: Use spare fob
fixSteps.instruction: Test with backup fob to isolate.

fixSteps.title: Dealer pairing
fixSteps.instruction: Program new fob at dealer if required.

videoSearchQuery: Indian motorcycle P1650 security fob fix

faq.a: Use PIN code via dash per owner's manual.
